title: 霍恩斯代爾儲能電站
subcategoryTitle: 電池儲能電站與電池系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Battery storage plants and battery systems
summary: 南澳的霍恩斯代爾儲能電站在 2017 年底以一百天內完工的賭約聞名，當時 100 MW／129 MWh 是世界最大的鋰電池，2020 年擴充到 150 MW；它緊鄰一座風場，卻不是用來儲存風電，而是在電網出事的瞬間以毫秒級的速度穩住頻率。課程定量分析機組跳脫後的頻率變化率、虛擬慣量能提供的功率、調頻成本的節省與它相對於風場的蓄電時數。
summaryEn: Hornsdale Power Reserve in South Australia became famous at the end of 2017 for a bet to finish within a hundred days; at 100 MW and 129 MWh it was then the world's largest lithium battery, expanded to 150 MW in 2020. It stands beside a wind farm yet is not there to store wind but to steady frequency within milliseconds when the grid is in trouble. The course quantifies rate of change of frequency after a unit trips, power virtual inertia can give, savings in frequency-control cost and hours of storage relative to the wind farm.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：霍恩斯代爾儲能電站
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Hornsdale Power Reserve
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「功率、能量與時長」與「相對於風場的蓄電時數」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power, energy and duration" and "Storage relative to the wind farm": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power, energy and duration" is correct?
options: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。
儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。
風場旁邊的電池就是用來儲存風電的。
optionsEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration.
The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating.
A battery beside a wind farm is there to store wind power.
quiz.explanation: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「功率、能量與時長」如何決定「霍恩斯代爾儲能電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power, energy and duration” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Hornsdale Power Reserve”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：初期規模為 100 MW／129 MWh，2017 年 12 月啟用
steps.observationEn: Project file: It opened in December 2017 at 100 MW and 129 MWh
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「功率、能量與時長」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power, energy and duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.

knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「功率、能量與時長」的模型 t = E / P，額定功率下的放電時長最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Power, energy and duration", which value is closest to the discharge duration at rated power?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 193.5 MWh、Pb = 150 MW，得 1.29 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 193.5 MWh, Pb = 150 MW the result is 1.29 h (discharge duration at rated power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「功率、能量與時長」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power, energy and duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 Eb = 193.5 MWh、Pb = 150 MW，得 1.29 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pb 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with Eb = 193.5 MWh, Pb = 150 MW the result is 1.29 h (discharge duration at rated power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pb by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.17 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 1.17 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.29 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pb 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.29 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pb with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 193.5 MWh、Pb = 150 MW，得 1.29 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 193.5 MWh, Pb = 150 MW the result is 1.29 h (discharge duration at rated power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.17 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 1.17 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power, energy and duration"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
電池容量太小，對大電網的頻率穩定沒有實質幫助。
依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Batteries are too small to help the frequency stability of a large grid in any real way.

Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「功率、能量與時長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power, energy and duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
knowledge.textEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.

knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62933 電能儲存系統標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62933 series on electrical energy storage systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「功率、能量與時長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Power, energy and duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「霍恩斯代爾儲能電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Hornsdale Power Reserve”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 相對於風場的蓄電時數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage relative to the wind farm: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「相對於風場的蓄電時數」如何決定「霍恩斯代爾儲能電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storage relative to the wind farm” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Hornsdale Power Reserve”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電池就蓋在風場旁邊，很多人以為它是用來「把風電存起來晚上用」。算一下就知道不是：把電池的能量除以風場的額定出力，它只能吸收風場滿載時半個多小時的發電量。這座電池的大部分容量簽給了州政府作為電網的保險，在頻率出問題時瞬間出力；剩下的才用來在電價低時充電、高時放電。它賺錢的方式是「快」，不是「多」。要把再生能源的電力移轉好幾個小時甚至好幾天，需要的是大上幾十倍的儲能。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The battery stands beside a wind farm, and many assume it stores wind for the night. A calculation shows otherwise: battery energy over the farm's rated output absorbs only a little over half an hour of full production. Most of its capacity is contracted to the state as insurance for the grid, delivering instantly when frequency is in trouble, and only the rest charges at low prices and discharges at high. It earns by being fast, not by holding much. Shifting renewable power by hours or days takes storage tens of times larger. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：2020 年容量擴充到 150 MW／193.5 MWh
steps.observationEn: Project file: It was expanded in 2020 to 150 MW and 193.5 MWh
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風場旁邊的電池就是用來儲存風電的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A battery beside a wind farm is there to store wind power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「相對於風場的蓄電時數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Storage relative to the wind farm”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：風場旁邊的電池就是用來儲存風電的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A battery beside a wind farm is there to store wind power. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「相對於風場的蓄電時數」的模型 t = E / P_w，電池能量 193.5 MWh 相對於風場額定出力 315 MW 的蓄電時間最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P_w for "Storage relative to the wind farm", which value is closest to the storage time of 193.5 MWh of battery against 315 MW of rated wind output?
options: 37 分鐘
369 分鐘
optionsEn: 37 minutes
369 minutes
18.4 minutes
quiz.explanation: t = E / P_w；代入 E = 193.5 MWh、Pw = 315 MW，得 37 分鐘（電池能量 193.5 MWh 相對於風場額定出力 315 MW 的蓄電時間）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P_w; with E = 193.5 MWh, Pw = 315 MW the result is 37 minutes (storage time of 193.5 MWh of battery against 315 MW of rated wind output). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 相對於風場的蓄電時數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage relative to the wind farm: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相對於風場的蓄電時數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Storage relative to the wind farm” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P_w；代入 E = 193.5 MWh、Pw = 315 MW，得 37 分鐘（電池能量 193.5 MWh 相對於風場額定出力 315 MW 的蓄電時間）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pw 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P_w; with E = 193.5 MWh, Pw = 315 MW the result is 37 minutes (storage time of 193.5 MWh of battery against 315 MW of rated wind output). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pw by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 34 分鐘（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pw by 10% changes the result to 34 minutes (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 37 分鐘（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pw 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 37 minutes (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pw with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P_w；代入 E = 193.5 MWh、Pw = 315 MW，得 37 分鐘（電池能量 193.5 MWh 相對於風場額定出力 315 MW 的蓄電時間）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P_w; with E = 193.5 MWh, Pw = 315 MW the result is 37 minutes (storage time of 193.5 MWh of battery against 315 MW of rated wind output).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 34 分鐘（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pw by 10% changes the result to 34 minutes (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相對於風場的蓄電時數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storage relative to the wind farm"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以運轉紀錄統計電池的充放電量中，頻率服務與能量套利各占多少比例。
只有轉動的發電機才能提供慣量。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Operating records show how much of the battery's charge and discharge goes to frequency services and how much to energy arbitrage.
Only spinning generators can provide inertia.
quiz.explanation: 以運轉紀錄統計電池的充放電量中，頻率服務與能量套利各占多少比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Operating records show how much of the battery's charge and discharge goes to frequency services and how much to energy arbitrage. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 相對於風場的蓄電時數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage relative to the wind farm: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相對於風場的蓄電時數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Storage relative to the wind farm” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以運轉紀錄統計電池的充放電量中，頻率服務與能量套利各占多少比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Operating records show how much of the battery's charge and discharge goes to frequency services and how much to energy arbitrage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：儲能的規格要依它要提供的服務決定：頻率服務重功率與速度，能量移轉重時長與成本。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify storage by the service it is to give: power and speed for frequency services, duration and cost for energy shifting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把這種短時長的電池當成解決再生能源間歇性的方案，會嚴重低估真正需要的儲能規模與成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating such a short-duration battery as the answer to renewable intermittency badly understates the scale and cost of storage really needed. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以運轉紀錄統計電池的充放電量中，頻率服務與能量套利各占多少比例。
knowledge.textEn: Operating records show how much of the battery's charge and discharge goes to frequency services and how much to energy arbitrage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 儲能的規格要依它要提供的服務決定：頻率服務重功率與速度，能量移轉重時長與成本。
knowledge.textEn: Specify storage by the service it is to give: power and speed for frequency services, duration and cost for energy shifting.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：UL 9540 儲能系統與設備／UL 9540A 熱失控延燒試驗方法。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: UL 9540 Energy Storage Systems and Equipment / UL 9540A thermal-runaway fire-propagation test method. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「相對於風場的蓄電時數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storage relative to the wind farm" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
電池系統的可靠度和單顆電芯一樣高。
把這種短時長的電池當成解決再生能源間歇性的方案，會嚴重低估真正需要的儲能規模與成本。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A battery system is as reliable as a single cell.
Treating such a short-duration battery as the answer to renewable intermittency badly understates the scale and cost of storage really needed.
quiz.explanation: 把這種短時長的電池當成解決再生能源間歇性的方案，會嚴重低估真正需要的儲能規模與成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating such a short-duration battery as the answer to renewable intermittency badly understates the scale and cost of storage really needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 相對於風場的蓄電時數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storage relative to the wind farm: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相對於風場的蓄電時數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Storage relative to the wind farm” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把這種短時長的電池當成解決再生能源間歇性的方案，會嚴重低估真正需要的儲能規模與成本。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「霍恩斯代爾儲能電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Treating such a short-duration battery as the answer to renewable intermittency badly understates the scale and cost of storage really needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Hornsdale Power Reserve”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要把再生能源的電力移轉好幾個小時甚至好幾天，需要的是大上幾十倍的儲能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shifting renewable power by hours or days takes storage tens of times larger.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風場旁邊的電池就是用來儲存風電的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A battery beside a wind farm is there to store wind power." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把這種短時長的電池當成解決再生能源間歇性的方案，會嚴重低估真正需要的儲能規模與成本。
knowledge.textEn: Treating such a short-duration battery as the answer to renewable intermittency badly understates the scale and cost of storage really needed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
